payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline models used in speech translation experiments, including their configurations and training methods.

claims.text: The baselines include a vanilla ST model, pre-training baselines (encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder pre-training), and multi-task baselines (one-to-many, many-to-one, many-to-many).
The pre-training baselines involve initializing the ST encoder from an ASR model and the ST decoder from an MT model, with different training datasets.
Multi-task baselines are designed to evaluate different configurations of task settings in speech translation.
